full_judgment: Mustafa Kamal, J.: Challenging an order dated 22-2-92 passed by the Prime Minister's Secretariat dissolving under Section 9(1) of the Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961 the then Executive Committee of Bangladesh Association for Voluntary Sterilization (BANS) and appointing defendant No.5 as Administrator thereof the petitioner claiming himself to be a life-founder Member of the Association filed Title Suit No.162 of 1994 in the 2nd Court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka against the respondents and the said suit was dismissed by judgment and decree dated 31-1-96. On appeal, Title Appeal No.54 of 1996, the 2nd Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka by judgment and decree dated 16-11-97 allowed the appeal and decreed the suit. The defendant-respondents preferred Civil Revision No.177 of 1998 in the High Court Division, a Single Bench whereof by judgment and order dated 25-3-98 made the Rule absolute and dismissed the suit, mainly on the ground that the petitioner as plain-tiff has no locus stand to agitate the matter of dissolving the Executive Committee of the said Association.
